name: Scorched Plateau

civilization.name: The Plateau Wardens
civilization.notes: A reptilian species that built an industrial civilization powered by solar energy. Climate shift has made their equatorial cities uninhabitable, forcing migration to the poles.

geological_features: Scorched basalt plateaus absorbing and radiating intense heat
Deep canyon systems providing shade and cooler temperatures
specific_features: Abandoned industrial cities on the equatorial plateaus
Active solar energy arrays maintained by automated systems
description: Scorched Plateau is a large desert world where dark basalt plateaus absorb and radiate solar energy with brutal efficiency. Equatorial surface temperatures exceed seventy degrees Celsius, hot enough to cause thermal injury to exposed skin. Deep canyon systems provide the only relief, their shaded floors tens of degrees cooler than the exposed plateaus above.

The breathable atmosphere is dry and carries the smell of hot stone. Heat shimmer distorts the horizon into a perpetual mirage, and the dark plateaus glow with radiated heat well into the night. The polar regions are cooler but still arid, their small ice caps retreating measurably with each passing decade.

The Plateau Wardens, a reptilian species with natural heat tolerance, built their civilization on the equatorial plateaus where solar energy was most abundant. For centuries they thrived, but a gradual climate shift has pushed temperatures beyond even their endurance. Their equatorial cities now stand abandoned, maintained only by automated solar arrays, as the population retreats poleward in an increasingly desperate migration.

Scorched Plateau presents a tragic case study in civilizational decline driven by environmental change. The Plateau Wardens possess industrial technology but lack the spacefaring capability to escape their world. Aid missions have been proposed but face political complications, as the Wardens' industrial output includes weapons-grade uranium processing. The question of whether to assist, and on what terms, divides the galactic community.
